# What a page raises outside a test body -- while it loads, or later from a
# timer -- fails the test that was running, on html as on the interpreter. A
# test agent sees only what a test body throws, so the page keeps what it
# raised for the generated test module to fail on.

! sngl test --platform=none load.sngl
stdout 'raised: boom \(on mount\)'

! sngl test --platform=html load.sngl
stdout 'the page raised while it loaded: Uncaught Error: boom'

! sngl test --platform=none click.sngl
stdout 'raised: boom \(on tick\)'

! sngl test --platform=html click.sngl
stdout 'the page raised: Uncaught Error: boom'
! stdout 'JSON'

-- load.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var n = 0
    effect(@mount { error.raise("boom", "on mount") })
    ui.text(value="{n}")
}

func testAfterALoadThatRaised(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.n == 0)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- click.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:time"

component main ui.node {
    var on = false
    var n = 0
    ui.button #go(text="go", @click { on = true })
    if on {
        time.timer(interval=10ms, enabled=true, @tick {
            n += 1
            error.raise("boom", "on tick")
        })
    }
}

func testATickThatRaises(t Test, c main) {
    c.go.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.n > 0, 1000)
    t.assert(c.n > 0)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
-- testrun/html/none/click.sngl/main/1 --

          "Message": "the page raised: Uncaught Error: boom"
        }
      ],
      "Log": [
        "the page raised: Uncaught Error: boom"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
